newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 13.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cloth company Uniwax announces turnover up by 8.38 percent in six months from April 1 to September 30 1996.
- Expo-CI 96 trade fair attracts more than 45,000 visitors in its first five days. Fair closes November 17.

- Opposition Ivorian Popular Front leader Laurent Gbagbo says constitutional amendments needed to strengthen democracy as part of President Henri Konan Bedie's efforts to bring opposition into government.
- Poverty in Ivory Coast: 32.2 percent of Ivorians below the poverty level; 42.5 percent of immigrants, expert says
